name: fusion
description: Nested multi-agent coding swarm + multi-model council. Architect (Fable 5.1 / Astra gpt-6-astra) designs a custom hive; captains are any live CLI (Codex, OpenCode/GLM, Grok, Copilot, Kimi, AndrewCode/Muse); nested workers are real AndrewCode processes talking on one Hive Board (WAL sqlite + JSONL, no daemon). Also conducts local CLI panelists through Fusion's bash adapters and a stdlib Python swarm backend (panel, council, debate, vote, swarm, MoA, heavy, graph, ladder, breaker, ballot, MetaLoop, hive).
